name: HaggleChimp – Price Bargaining Bot
author: chimpjar

sections.description:
HaggleChimp is a lightweight, gamified price negotiation bot for WooCommerce stores. Instead of passive browsing, let your visitors negotiate discounts interactively on single product pages!

Research shows that customers who feel they “earned” a discount through bargaining are 3x more likely to complete checkout.

🌟 Key Features:

  • Interactive Negotiation Bot: Modern, beautiful popup chat widget on product pages.
  • Winning Probability Meter: Real-time visual progress bar showing users their chances of winning.
  • 1-Click Quick Offer Chips: Pre-calculated discount suggestion buttons for instant offers.
  • Auto-Apply Coupon & Cart: Automatically creates a limited-time coupon and takes the buyer straight to checkout.
  • 100% Theme-Proof CSS Shield: Fully isolated styling ensuring it looks pixel-perfect on Astra, Hello Elementor, Divi, WoodMart, and more.
  • Trigger Button Customizer: Customize button padding and border-radius to seamlessly match your theme’s “Add to Cart” button.

👑 Looking for More Power? Upgrade to HaggleChimp PRO:

  • Per-Product Minimum Pricing: Set custom minimum acceptance prices per product.
  • Mandatory Email Lead Capture: Require customer emails to unlock discount coupons.
  • 1-Click CSV Export: Download collected high-intent leads instantly.
  • Revenue Analytics: Track exact sales revenue and conversion rates generated by the bot.
  • Full Design Customizer: Upload custom avatar logos, pick brand colors, and edit dialogue messages.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the hagglechimp folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the ZIP directly via your WordPress Admin (Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin).
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to HaggleChimp in your WordPress dashboard to set your store-wide maximum discount percentage.
  4. Visit any product page on your site to test the bargaining bot!
sections.faq:
Does this require WooCommerce?

Yes, HaggleChimp requires WooCommerce to be active.

Will this slow down my website?

Not at all! HaggleChimp is vanilla JavaScript and native lightweight PHP with zero external dependencies.

Does it work with my WordPress Theme?

Yes! HaggleChimp comes with built-in CSS isolation and a button dimension customizer that guarantees compatibility with all modern WooCommerce themes.
